text: 6. Suspension / Revocation GAEIS issued shall be liable to be suspended/revoked by the DGFT on receipt of an adverse report on proliferation concern or for non-submission of mandatory post- shipment details/reports/documents within the prescribed timelines or non- compliance with the conditions of the proposed policy.
